original_content_full: The paper "Augmenting Library Development by Mining Usage Data from Downstream Dependencies" by Christoph Thiede, Willy Scheibel, Daniel Limberger, and Jürgen Döllner was accepted for publication and presentation at the 17th International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Appraoches to Software Engineering. The conference will take place as virtual-only event between April 25-26, 2022.
